slot_scores.name: missing_vat_sequence
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the sequence of vats fixed as vat 1 then vat 2 then vat 3 for every batch, or can the order in which a batch visits the three vats vary?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether all batches must follow the fixed vat 1 -> vat 2 -> vat 3 sequence, directly covering the hidden slot's key meaning.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P1 hidden slot, H1, was explicitly asked and confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL. No unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent conducted a focused clarification interview, explicitly confirming the fixed vat sequence and other scheduling assumptions before summarizing the flow shop model. Interaction quality was strong with no major hidden-slot misses.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
